meta.description: Minimum DQ expectations for Bronze (raw ingest) tables. Thresholds are intentionally permissive — Bronze accepts raw data as-is. Tune mostly_values after profiling real data volumes.
meta.when_to_run: After each AutoLoader / streaming write batch, before Silver promotion.

meta.notes: Fail if batch is empty — indicates upstream source issue or misconfigured AutoLoader path.
Every Bronze row must carry an ingestion timestamp for lineage and freshness checks.
Ingestion timestamp must always be populated.
Source file path — populated by AutoLoader cloudFiles reader. Adjust column name if using a different ingest method.
Every row should trace back to a source file.
Ingest timestamp must be a proper Spark TimestampType, not a string.
Metadata columns must be present. Payload columns vary by source — set exact_match=false.
